last_result.headline: N9 closed: self-correlation is real but weaker than the typewell. Prefix coverage is ample (63.5% of toe rows within 0.5ft of true TVT) so the failure is not for lack of opportunity: held-out-WELL AUC 0.6628 vs the typewell control 0.7706, and the combined arm (0.7605 +/- 0.0057) does not beat the control either. Mechanism isolated: 0.7174 on prefix-covered states vs 0.4548 (below chance) on uncovered, so the interpolation fallback is harmful and any future use must be coverage-gated.
